info.title: Social News API
info.description:
REST API for the Social News App. Two clients consume it: the **Mobile App** (users + reporters) and the **Web Admin Panel** (admins). This spec covers only endpoints that are actually implemented in this codebase (see `src/routes/v1`).

**Response envelope** — every success response has the shape `{ success: true, statusCode, message, data }`. Every error response has the shape `{ success: false, statusCode, message }`.

**Known gaps (not yet fixed, documented here so integrators aren't surprised):**
- `GET /news/:id` has no auth gate, so an owner/admin viewing their own non-public post gets 404 instead of 200.
- `/admin/categories/*` currently has NO auth gate at all (`requireAdmin` is commented out in the route file) — anyone can call it.
- Category-follow based feed filtering on `GET /news` has a known logic bug.

post.description: OTP-based login. Get an OTP first via `POST /auth/forgot-password` or your own OTP-issuance flow, then exchange identifier+otp for tokens.

rejectionReason.description: Non-empty only when status is FAILED

post.description: Find-or-create on the decoded Google token's email/sub. New accounts are created immediately with `isTopicsSelected: false`; the client should follow up with POST/PUT `/categories/assign/{userId}` once the user picks topics, which flips `isTopicsSelected` to true. Pass `journalistId` (from the "Join as Agency Reporter" screen) to sign up as a reporter: the account is created/upgraded to `role: reporter_pending` with `reporterProfile.approvalStatus: pending` until an admin approves it (existing `reporter`/`reporter_pending` accounts are never downgraded by this).

post.description: Server-to-server only. Body must be the raw bytes Stripe sent (the route is mounted before the global JSON body parser specifically to preserve this). Verifies the `stripe-signature` header against `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. Not callable meaningfully from Swagger UI / Postman without a real Stripe-signed payload.
